name: Reference Extravaganza
description: Supercharge Thymer references. Type [[ to reference any line of text inline (search, pick, insert). Set an alias on any reference, page or line, to change what its chip shows without recreating the link: the box pre-fills with the current title so you can trim it down. Inline Transclusion: expand a selected reference in place with Cmd/Ctrl+Down (Cmd/Ctrl+Up collapses) to see and edit what it points to, nested right under it. Many embeds stay open at once and persist across reload; expanding a page reference also shows an EDITABLE property card (Status, Due, relations, etc.) above the body, keyboard-navigable like a native record (press Down from the reference to arrow through and edit its properties). Commands: "Set alias for reference" (shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+A, rebindable via "Set alias keyboard shortcut"), "Collapse all embeds (this page)".
